<?php

class CircuitBreaker {
    private $failureCount = 0;
    private $successCount = 0;
    private $state = 'closed';
    private $lastFailureTime = 0;
    private $threshold = 5;
    private $timeout = 30;
    private $redis;

    public function __construct($redis) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
    }

    public function getState(): string {
        if ($this->state === 'open') {
            if (time() - $this->lastFailureTime >= $this->timeout) {
                $this->state = 'half-open';
            }
        }
        return $this->state;
    }

    public function recordSuccess(): void {
        $this->failureCount = 0;
        $this->successCount++;
        if ($this->state === 'half-open') {
            $this->state = 'closed';
        }
    }

    public function recordFailure(): void {
        $this->failureCount++;
        $this->lastFailureTime = time();
        if ($this->failureCount >= $this->threshold) {
            $this->state = 'open';
        }
    }

    public function isAvailable(): bool {
        return $this->getState() !== 'open';
    }
}

class JobSerializer {
    /**
     * Encode job payload for safe transport across queue boundaries.
     * Uses base64 to preserve binary data integrity.
     */
    public static function encode(array $payload): string {
        return base64_encode(json_encode($payload));
    }

    /**
     * Decode job payload from queue message.
     * Validates structure before returning.
     */
    public static function decode(string $raw): ?array {
        $json = base64_decode($raw, true);
        if ($json === false) return null;
        $data = json_decode($json, true);
        if (!is_array($data)) return null;
        return $data;
    }
}

class CommandBuilder {
    private static $allowedBinaries = [
        'convert' => '/usr/bin/convert',
        'ffmpeg' => '/usr/bin/ffmpeg',
        'pdftk' => '/usr/bin/pdftk',
        'gs' => '/usr/bin/gs',
    ];

    /**
     * Build a safe command string from structured job data.
     * Only allows whitelisted binaries and validates arguments.
     */
    public static function build(array $job): ?string {
        $tool = $job['tool'] ?? null;
        if (!isset(self::$allowedBinaries[$tool])) {
            return null;
        }

        $binary = self::$allowedBinaries[$tool];
        $args = $job['arguments'] ?? [];

        if (!is_array($args)) return null;

        $sanitizedArgs = self::sanitizeArguments($args);
        return $binary . ' ' . $sanitizedArgs;
    }

    /**
     * Sanitize each argument using escapeshellarg to prevent injection.
     * Handles nested argument structures for complex tool invocations.
     */
    private static function sanitizeArguments(array $args): string {
        $parts = [];
        foreach ($args as $key => $value) {
            if (is_int($key)) {
                // Positional argument
                $parts[] = self::escapeValue($value);
            } else {
                // Named argument (flag)
                $flag = self::escapeFlag($key);
                if ($value === true) {
                    $parts[] = $flag;
                } else {
                    $parts[] = $flag . ' ' . self::escapeValue($value);
                }
            }
        }
        return implode(' ', $parts);
    }

    private static function escapeFlag(string $flag): string {
        // Flags must start with - and contain only alphanumeric/dashes
        $clean = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9\-]/', '', $flag);
        return '-' . ltrim($clean, '-');
    }

    private static function escapeValue($value): string {
        if (is_array($value)) {
            // Complex argument: join sub-values with the tool's expected delimiter
            return implode(' ', array_map('escapeshellarg', 
                array_map('strval', $value)));
        }
        return escapeshellarg((string)$value);
    }
}

class BackgroundWorker {
    private $circuitBreaker;
    private $redis;
    private $logFile;
    private $workerName;

    public function __construct($redis, string $workerName = 'default') {
        $this->redis = $redis;
        $this->circuitBreaker = new CircuitBreaker($redis);
        $this->workerName = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/', '', $workerName);
        $this->logFile = '/var/log/workers/' . $this->workerName . '.log';
    }

    public function processQueue(string $queueName): void {
        while (true) {
            if (!$this->circuitBreaker->isAvailable()) {
                $this->log('Circuit open, sleeping...');
                sleep(5);
                continue;
            }

            $rawMessage = $this->redis->brpop($queueName, 5);
            if ($rawMessage === null) continue;

            $payload = JobSerializer::decode($rawMessage[1]);
            if ($payload === null) {
                $this->log('Invalid payload, skipping');
                continue;
            }

            $this->executeJob($payload);
        }
    }

    private function executeJob(array $payload): void {
        $jobType = $payload['type'] ?? 'unknown';

        switch ($jobType) {
            case 'media_transform':
                $this->handleMediaTransform($payload);
                break;
            case 'document_process':
                $this->handleDocumentProcess($payload);
                break;
            case 'notification':
                $this->handleNotification($payload);
                break;
            default:
                $this->log("Unknown job type: $jobType");
        }
    }

    private function handleMediaTransform(array $payload): void {
        $command = CommandBuilder::build($payload);
        if ($command === null) {
            $this->log('Invalid media transform command');
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure();
            return;
        }

        $this->runCommand($command, $payload);
    }

    private function handleDocumentProcess(array $payload): void {
        $command = CommandBuilder::build($payload);
        if ($command === null) {
            $this->log('Invalid document process command');
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure();
            return;
        }

        $this->runCommand($command, $payload);
    }

    private function handleNotification(array $payload): void {
        $recipient = $payload['recipient'] ?? '';
        $message = $payload['message'] ?? '';
        // Notification handling via internal API, no shell involved
        $this->log("Notification sent to: $recipient");
        $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess();
    }

    private function runCommand(string $command, array $payload): void {
        $callbackScript = $payload['callback'] ?? null;
        
        $output = [];
        $returnCode = 0;
        exec($command, $output, $returnCode);

        if ($returnCode === 0) {
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess();
            $this->log('Command succeeded: ' . substr($command, 0, 80));
            
            // Execute post-processing callback if specified
            if ($callbackScript !== null) {
                $this->runPostCallback($callbackScript, $output);
            }
        } else {
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure();
            $this->log('Command failed with code ' . $returnCode);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Run post-processing callback script.
     * Callbacks are PHP scripts in the registered callbacks directory.
     */
    private function runPostCallback(string $callback, array $output): void {
        // Normalize the callback identifier
        $callbackId = basename($callback);
        $callbackDir = '/opt/workers/callbacks';
        
        // Build the callback execution command
        $outputData = implode("\n", $output);
        $encodedOutput = base64_encode($outputData);
        
        // Use php to run the callback with output data as argument
        $cmd = sprintf(
            '/usr/bin/php %s/%s --data %s',
            $callbackDir,
            $callbackId,
            $encodedOutput
        );
        
        exec($cmd);
    }

    private function log(string $message): void {
        $timestamp = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $entry = "[$timestamp] [{$this->workerName}] $message" . PHP_EOL;
        file_put_contents($this->logFile, $entry, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }
}
